description: Cost of the context interface: no FACT; openat markers (collector fact-all.bt, fact_policy cred=0, both attach a probe to every openat on the host); execution credential (collector fact-cred.bt, fact_policy cred=1: the switch is prctl(PR_FACT) authorized by the BPF LSM, no openat probe). Each run measures connect() latency with two switches per connection (bench/connect_bench.c) and open()+close() latency of an unrelated file (bench/open_bench.c), i.e., what the interface costs processes that never use it; bpf_stats gives the eBPF time per program.
